summary: Dense residential street; houses about 17 m from the kerb, few parked cars.
reasons: Homes about 17 m away all round

best_section.where: Lower half of the street, before the T-junction at the bottom

drivers.seclusion: Houses on both sides, the nearest about 17 m from the kerb; no bush or park behind.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parking on both sides; a van fits at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet suburban street, no through traffic apparent.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along this street; No Stopping sign only at the start.
